doc.title: Vince Lateano interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

title: Break chatter about Eddie Marshall and Eddie Alley
summary: Talk of Eddie Marshall and a mix-up with Eddie Alley.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: Am I allowing you to talk enough?
Yes, I’m having a field day here.
Eddie’s cool, you’ll have fun with Eddie. Eddie Marshall?
He said he was going to drive here, and I was a little — I mean I don’t know the guy but he’s ninety-some, right?
Oh, no, I thought you said—
No, no Eddie Alley, he’s together. But Eddie Marshall. Yeah he’s cool.
